name: plumage
description: Plumage's skills for the form of the work, packaged as installable plugins from one repository.

plugins.name: writing-prose
plugins.description: Drafts, revises and reviews prose signed in the author's own voice, with register control against LLM-default rhetoric.

plugins.name: writing-design-canons
plugins.description: Produces layered design canons a team uses to make assets in a coherent style and stakeholders use to review them.

plugins.name: importing-design-figures
plugins.description: Turns a Claude Design figure or table into a print-quality image placed, undistorted, into a local document.

plugins.name: coining-neologisms
plugins.description: Coins a precise new word and its morphological family for a concept that lacks a compact name.

plugins.name: pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Converts digital-native PDFs into Markdown with figures embedded where they belong, using poppler and pandoc.
